name: Command
description: Fast, composable command menu for Phlex.

files.content:
# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Root of a command menu (shadcn's Command). Works inline on the page or
  # inside CommandDialogContent. Typing in CommandInput filters the items; the
  # first visible item is active, arrow keys, Home and End move the active item
  # and Enter selects it. loop: true lets the arrow keys wrap around.
  class Command < Base
    def initialize(loop: false, **attrs)
      @loop = loop
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        class: "flex size-full flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-xl! bg-popover p-1 text-popover-foreground",
        data: {
          slot: "command",
          controller: "ruby-ui--command",
          ruby_ui__command_loop_value: @loop.to_s
        }
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The modal panel of a CommandDialog: a Dialog content pinned at a third of
  # the viewport, with the dialog's sr-only title and description.
  class CommandDialogContent < Base
    def view_template(&block)
      settings = context[:ruby_ui_command_dialog] || {}
      render DialogContent.new(show_close_button: settings.fetch(:show_close_button, false), **attrs) do
        div(class: "sr-only") do
          render DialogTitle.new { settings.fetch(:title, "Command Palette") }
          render DialogDescription.new { settings.fetch(:description, "Search for a command to run...") }
        end
        yield if block
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {class: "top-1/3 translate-y-0 overflow-hidden rounded-xl! p-0"}
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Opens the CommandDialog on click and on its keybindings (⌘K / Ctrl+K by
  # default; Stimulus key filters, e.g. "keydown.meta+j@window").
  class CommandDialogTrigger < Base
    DEFAULT_KEYBINDINGS = [
      "keydown.ctrl+k@window",
      "keydown.meta+k@window"
    ].freeze

    def initialize(keybindings: DEFAULT_KEYBINDINGS, **attrs)
      @keybindings = keybindings.map { |kb| "#{kb}->ruby-ui--dialog#open" }
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      render DialogTrigger.new(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {data: {action: @keybindings.join(" ")}}
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Shown only while a search matches no item. Put it inside CommandList.
  class CommandEmpty < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "presentation",
        hidden: true,
        class: "py-6 text-center text-sm",
        data: {slot: "command-empty", ruby_ui__command_target: "empty"}
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The search field of a Command: an input group with a search icon. The
  # input is the combobox that controls CommandList; extra attributes go to the
  # <input>.
  class CommandInput < Base
    # shadcn's InputGroup focus ring targets data-slot=input-group-control,
    # which cmdk's input doesn't carry, so the command input shows no ring.
    INPUT_GROUP = "group/input-group relative flex w-full min-w-0 items-center outline-none " \
      "h-8! rounded-lg! border border-input/30 bg-input/30 shadow-none!"

    ADDON = "order-first flex h-auto cursor-text items-center justify-center gap-2 py-1.5 pl-2! " \
      "text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground select-none"

    def initialize(placeholder: "Type a command or search...", **attrs)
      @placeholder = placeholder
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template
      div(class: "p-1 pb-0", data: {slot: "command-input-wrapper"}) do
        div(class: INPUT_GROUP, role: "group", data: {slot: "input-group"}) do
          input(**attrs)
          div(class: ADDON, role: "group", data: {slot: "input-group-addon", align: "inline-start", action: "click->ruby-ui--command#focusInput"}) do
            search_icon
          end
        end
      end
    end

    private

    def search_icon
      svg(
        xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
        viewbox: "0 0 24 24",
        fill: "none",
        stroke: "currentColor",
        stroke_width: "2",
        stroke_linecap: "round",
        stroke_linejoin: "round",
        aria_hidden: "true",
        class: "size-4 shrink-0 opacity-50"
      ) do |s|
        s.path(d: "m21 21-4.34-4.34")
        s.circle(cx: "11", cy: "11", r: "8")
      end
    end

    def default_attrs
      {
        type: "text",
        role: "combobox",
        placeholder: @placeholder,
        autocomplete: "off",
        autocorrect: "off",
        autocapitalize: "none",
        spellcheck: "false",
        autofocus: true,
        aria: {autocomplete: "list", expanded: "true"},
        class: "h-full w-full min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-none border-0 bg-transparent py-1 pr-2 pl-1.5 text-sm shadow-none outline-hidden ring-0 " \
          "focus:ring-0 focus-visible:ring-0 placeholder:text-muted-foreground disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50",
        data: {
          slot: "command-input",
          ruby_ui__command_target: "input",
          action: "input->ruby-ui--command#filter keydown->ruby-ui--command#inputKeydown"
        }
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # An option of a Command. value: is what the search matches (the item's text
  # when omitted), keywords: adds more terms. Selecting it (click or Enter on
  # the active item) dispatches a cancelable `ruby-ui--command:select` event
  # and, unless prevented, visits href: when given (Turbo.visit when Turbo is
  # loaded). disabled: items can't be made active or selected.
  class CommandItem < Base
    def initialize(value: nil, keywords: [], href: nil, disabled: false, **attrs)
      @value = value
      @keywords = Array(keywords)
      @href = href
      @disabled = disabled
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "option",
        aria: {selected: "false", disabled: (@disabled ? "true" : nil)},
        class: [
          "group/command-item relative flex cursor-default items-center gap-2 rounded-sm px-2 py-1.5 text-sm outline-hidden select-none",
          "in-[dialog]:rounded-lg! data-selected:bg-muted data-selected:text-foreground data-selected:**:[svg]:text-foreground",
          "data-[disabled=true]:pointer-events-none data-[disabled=true]:opacity-50",
          "[&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4"
        ],
        data: {
          slot: "command-item",
          value: @value,
          keywords: (@keywords.join(" ") if @keywords.any?),
          href: @href,
          disabled: (@disabled ? "true" : nil),
          ruby_ui__command_target: "item",
          action: "click->ruby-ui--command#itemClick pointermove->ruby-ui--command#itemPointermove"
        }
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The listbox of a Command. It scrolls past 18rem (max-h-72).
  class CommandList < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "listbox",
        tabindex: "-1",
        class: "max-h-72 scroll-py-1 overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-auto outline-none [scrollbar-width:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden",
        data: {slot: "command-list", ruby_ui__command_target: "list"}
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # A rule between CommandGroups, hidden while a search is typed.
  class CommandSeparator < Base
    def view_template
      div(**attrs)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "separator",
        class: "-mx-1 h-px w-auto bg-border",
        data: {slot: "command-separator", ruby_ui__command_target: "separator"}
      }
    end
  end
end

# Command

Fast, composable command menu for Phlex.

## Usage

### Inline

```ruby
div(class: "w-full max-w-md rounded-xl ring-1 ring-foreground/10") do
  Command do
    CommandInput(placeholder: "Type a command or search...")
    CommandList do
      CommandEmpty { "No results found." }
      CommandGroup(title: "Suggestions") do
        CommandItem(value: "Calendar") do
          svg(xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", viewbox: "0 0 24 24", fill: "none", stroke: "currentColor", stroke_width: "2", stroke_linecap: "round", stroke_linejoin: "round", aria_hidden: "true") do |s|
            s.path(d: "M8 2v4"); s.path(d: "M16 2v4"); s.rect(width: "18", height: "18", x: "3", y: "4", rx: "2"); s.path(d: "M3 10h18")
          end
          span { "Calendar" }
        end
        CommandItem(value: "Search Emoji") do
          svg(xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", viewbox: "0 0 24 24", fill: "none", stroke: "currentColor", stroke_width: "2", stroke_linecap: "round", stroke_linejoin: "round", aria_hidden: "true") do |s|
            s.circle(cx: "12", cy: "12", r: "10"); s.path(d: "M8 14s1.5 2 4 2 4-2 4-2"); s.line(x1: "9", x2: "9.01", y1: "9", y2: "9"); s.line(x1: "15", x2: "15.01", y1: "9", y2: "9")
          end
          span { "Search Emoji" }
        end
        CommandItem(value: "Calculator", disabled: true) do
          svg(xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", viewbox: "0 0 24 24", fill: "none", stroke: "currentColor", stroke_width: "2", stroke_linecap: "round", stroke_linejoin: "round", aria_hidden: "true") do |s|
            s.rect(width: "16", height: "20", x: "4", y: "2", rx: "2"); s.line(x1: "8", x2: "16", y1: "6", y2: "6"); s.path(d: "M16 14v4"); s.path(d: "M8 10h.01"); s.path(d: "M12 10h.01"); s.path(d: "M16 10h.01"); s.path(d: "M8 14h.01"); s.path(d: "M12 14h.01"); s.path(d: "M8 18h.01"); s.path(d: "M12 18h.01")
          end
          span { "Calculator" }
        end
      end
      CommandSeparator()
      CommandGroup(title: "Settings") do
        CommandItem(value: "Profile") do
          span { "Profile" }
          CommandShortcut { "⌘P" }
        end
        CommandItem(value: "Billing") do
          span { "Billing" }
          CommandShortcut { "⌘B" }
        end
        CommandItem(value: "Settings") do
          span { "Settings" }
          CommandShortcut { "⌘S" }
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### Dialog

```ruby
CommandDialog(title: "Command menu", description: "Choose an action") do
  CommandDialogTrigger(keybindings: []) do
    Button(variant: :outline) { "Open Menu" }
  end
  CommandDialogContent do
    Command do
      CommandInput(placeholder: "Type a command or search...")
      CommandList do
        CommandEmpty { "No results found." }
        CommandGroup(title: "Suggestions") do
          CommandItem { "Calendar" }
          CommandItem { "Search Emoji" }
          CommandItem { "Calculator" }
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### With shortcuts

```ruby
CommandDialog do
  CommandDialogTrigger(keybindings: ["keydown.ctrl+j@window", "keydown.meta+j@window"]) do
    Button(variant: :outline) { "Open Menu (⌘J)" }
  end
  CommandDialogContent do
    Command do
      CommandInput(placeholder: "Type a command or search...")
      CommandList do
        CommandEmpty { "No results found." }
        CommandGroup(title: "Settings") do
          CommandItem(value: "Profile") do
            span { "Profile" }
            CommandShortcut { "⌘P" }
          end
          CommandItem(value: "Billing") do
            span { "Billing" }
            CommandShortcut { "⌘B" }
          end
          CommandItem(value: "Settings") do
            span { "Settings" }
            CommandShortcut { "⌘S" }
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### Navigation

```ruby
CommandDialog(title: "Search documentation", description: "Find a page in the docs") do
  CommandDialogTrigger(keybindings: []) do
    Button(variant: :outline) { "Search docs" }
  end
  CommandDialogContent do
    Command do
      CommandInput(placeholder: "Search documentation...")
      CommandList do
        CommandEmpty { "No results found." }
        CommandGroup(title: "Components") do
          CommandItem(value: "Accordion", href: docs_accordion_path) { "Accordion" }
          CommandItem(value: "Alert", href: docs_alert_path) { "Alert" }
          CommandItem(value: "Alert Dialog", href: docs_alert_dialog_path, keywords: ["confirm", "modal"]) { "Alert Dialog" }
          CommandItem(value: "Badge", href: docs_badge_path) { "Badge" }
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### Handling selection

```ruby
div(class: "w-full max-w-md rounded-xl ring-1 ring-foreground/10") do
  Command(loop: true, data: {action: "ruby-ui--command:select->my-palette#run"}) do
    CommandInput(placeholder: "Run an action...")
    CommandList do
      CommandEmpty { "No results found." }
      CommandGroup(title: "Actions") do
        CommandItem(value: "new-file") { "New file" }
        CommandItem(value: "new-folder") { "New folder" }
        CommandItem(value: "rename") { "Rename" }
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### Scrollable

```ruby
CommandDialog do
  CommandDialogTrigger(keybindings: []) do
    Button(variant: :outline) { "Open Menu" }
  end
  CommandDialogContent do
    Command do
      CommandInput(placeholder: "Type a command or search...")
      CommandList do
        CommandEmpty { "No results found." }
        CommandGroup(title: "Navigation") do
          %w[Home Inbox Documents Downloads Desktop Pictures Music Videos].each { |name| CommandItem { name } }
        end
        CommandSeparator()
        CommandGroup(title: "Tools") do
          %w[Calculator Calendar Clock Notes Terminal Weather].each { |name| CommandItem { name } }
        end
        CommandSeparator()
        CommandGroup(title: "Settings") do
          %w[Profile Billing Notifications Privacy Appearance Language].each { |name| CommandItem { name } }
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
```
